import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlparse

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = ROOT / 'VizTell'
FOLDER = 'docs/软件与系统工程宇宙/'
DOCS = [FOLDER + n for n in ['00_AI原生研发总体框架与关键结论.md',
                            '07_研发工作流与工程能力关系.md', '90_研究缺口与续研任务.md']]
SNAP = FOLDER + 'snapshots/development-workflow-r2-validation-2026-11-27.json'
failures, references, structure = [], [], []


def git(repo, *args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=repo, capture_output=True)


for name in DOCS:
    p = REPO / name
    content = p.read_text()
    fences = re.findall(r'^\s*```', content, re.M)
    table_count, width = 0, None
    for i, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), 1):
        if line.startswith('|') and line.rstrip().endswith('|'):
            cols = len(re.split(r'(?<!\\)\|', line)) - 2
            if width is None:
                table_count += 1
                width = cols
            elif cols != width:
                failures.append({'kind': 'table_width', 'path': name, 'line': i, 'expected': width, 'actual': cols})
        else:
            width = None
    if len(fences) % 2:
        failures.append({'kind': 'unbalanced_code_fences', 'path': name})
    structure.append({'path': name, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      'tables': table_count, 'balanced_fences': len(fences) % 2 == 0,
                      'scope': 'Markdown source structure, not browser rendering'})
    for match in re.finditer(r'\[[^\]\n]*\]\(([^)\s]+)\)', content):
        target = match.group(1)
        item = {'source': name, 'target': target}
        parsed = urlparse(target)
        if parsed.scheme:
            blob = re.fullmatch(r'https://github.com/shopable-ai/([^/]+)/blob/([0-9a-f]{40})/(.+)', target.split('#', 1)[0])
            commit = re.fullmatch(r'https://github.com/shopable-ai/([^/]+)/commit/([0-9a-f]{40})', target)
            if blob:
                repo_name, revision, file_path = blob.groups()
                file_path = unquote(file_path)
                result = git(ROOT / repo_name, 'cat-file', '-e', revision + ':' + file_path)
                item.update(kind='pinned_git_file', exists=result.returncode == 0, revision=revision, path=file_path)
            elif commit:
                repo_name, revision = commit.groups()
                result = git(ROOT / repo_name, 'cat-file', '-t', revision)
                item.update(kind='pinned_git_commit', exists=result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip() == b'commit')
            else:
                item.update(kind='preexisting_external_entry', status='not_rechecked_in_this_bounded_doc_check')
        else:
            path_part, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
            dest = (p.parent / unquote(path_part)).resolve() if path_part else p
            item.update(kind='local_target', resolved_path=str(dest.relative_to(REPO)), exists=dest.exists())
            if anchor in ['r2-followup', 'r2-validation', 'r2-chain-map'] and dest.exists():
                item['explicit_anchor'] = anchor
                item['anchor_exists'] = f'id="{anchor}"' in dest.read_text()
                if not item['anchor_exists']:
                    failures.append({'kind': 'missing_explicit_anchor', **item})
        if item.get('exists') is False:
            failures.append({'kind': 'missing_reference_target', **item})
        references.append(item)

record = json.loads((REPO / SNAP).read_text())
raw_count = 0


def verify_raw(value):
    global raw_count
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        if 'verbatim_utf8' in value:
            raw_count += 1
            actual = hashlib.sha256(value['verbatim_utf8'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
            if actual != value['sha256']:
                failures.append({'kind': 'embedded_raw_hash', 'source': value.get('source_path')})
        for child in value.values():
            verify_raw(child)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for child in value:
            verify_raw(child)


verify_raw(record)
for row in structure:
    if record['candidate_document_sha256'][row['path']] != row['sha256']:
        failures.append({'kind': 'document_binding', 'path': row['path']})
scoring = record['scoring']
scores = [x['score'] for x in scoring['scores']]
if len(scores) != 6 or sum(scores) != scoring['sum_for_arithmetic_only'] or sum(scores) / 6 != scoring['arithmetic_mean']:
    failures.append({'kind': 'score_arithmetic'})
if f"{sum(scores) / 6:.2f}" not in (REPO / DOCS[1]).read_text():
    failures.append({'kind': 'score_not_in_guide'})
check = git(REPO, 'diff', '--check')
if check.returncode:
    failures.append({'kind': 'git_diff_check', 'stderr': check.stderr.decode(), 'stdout': check.stdout.decode()})
report = {
    'task_id': record['task_id'], 'run_id': record['run_id'],
    'checked_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'Changed research entry source structure, file targets, explicit new anchors, score arithmetic and embedded raw evidence hashes. No product/runtime/model experiment.',
    'documents': structure, 'references': references,
    'reference_summary': {kind: sum(x['kind'] == kind for x in references) for kind in sorted({x['kind'] for x in references})},
    'embedded_verbatim_records_checked': raw_count,
    'score_mean': scoring['display_mean'],
    'git_diff_check': {'exit_code': check.returncode, 'stdout': check.stdout.decode(), 'stderr': check.stderr.decode()},
    'failures': failures, 'status': 'PASS' if not failures else 'FAIL',
    'snapshot_sha256_at_check': hashlib.sha256((REPO / SNAP).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'snapshot_hash_scope_note': 'This is the actual input hash before embedding this check receipt or later review addenda; not a self-referential final-envelope hash.',
    'checker_script_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
(ROOT / 'r2-opt-document-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ['status', 'reference_summary', 'embedded_verbatim_records_checked', 'score_mean', 'failures']}, ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(bool(failures))
